Adversarial: a dead/fake app that ignores the seed fails seed-text criteria (signin_and_client_scope, wall_every_route, deleted_and_expired_seed_messages); a conforming app that reads /assets/kittle.json directly instead of copying it still finds it in the verifier via the /assets artifact.
